issues.title: Add retry/backoff to the API client
issues.spec: Add a retry/backoff policy to the API client's send() path. On a 5xx or a network error, retry with exponential backoff (base 200ms, factor 2, max 5 attempts, jitter). Surface the final failure to the caller unchanged once attempts are exhausted. This is a single cohesive concern — the backoff schedule, the retry predicate, and the give-up behaviour are one indivisible unit of work on one code path (client.send()), not two independent tickets.

question: Does ISS-T's spec cover two structurally-independent, each-ticket-sized concerns (splittable)? If so, list the independent concerns; if it is one cohesive concern, return an empty list.
